alex_chung: Heads up — Datadog asked for a quick alignment on sampler behavior for the private marketplace tile. They saw traffic duplicated when customers enable both our prefix-KV sampling and their agent sampler. Can we confirm what the console will surface?

maria_gonzalez: Good catch. We currently expose a global sampling toggle + per-route override in the Console. Default is off for customers who install the DD agent, but I don't think it's communicated in the marketplace tile yet.

derek_liu: If we leave both enabled, you'll double-sample at ingestion. For tracing the key is: only one sampler should drop spans. Our runtime can emit a header `x-rw-sampled` to indicate a decision. We could add an auto-detect handshake with the OTLP exporter to turn off the runtime sampler when it sees Datadog headers.

kai_ng: Auto-detect sounds nice but might be risky for private/offline installs. Suggest a conservative plan: 1) marketplace tile README documents sampler guidance, 2) Console shows a one-click compatibility toggle labeled "Datadog agent / OTLP downstream: disable runtime sampler" and 3) an ops-check during onboarding that validates no duplicate traces in a smoke run.

pm_sam: +1 to the DL plan. PM asks for minimal friction for SIs — we should ship a default manifest for the tile that sets the toggle for recommended partners (e.g., Datadog, NewRelic).

ellen_wu: For the tile manifest, can we include an example otlp config snippet? Something like:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: "${DD_API_KEY}"
```
and then a note: "Set runtime_sampler = off when using datadog exporter".

maria_gonzalez: That snippet + short copy should be fine. Derek, how hard is adding the `x-rw-sampled` header opt-in? We can make the Console toggle flip that behavior.

derek_liu: It's small on the runtime side — add flag to attach header when sampling decision is made. The trick is: Datadog expects `traceparent`/`tracestate` and we must not break propagation. Header is just an auxiliary signal for our admin checks. I'll prep a PR for runtime and another for the Console flag.

opsbot: deploybot: staging deploy started for branch feature/dd-sampler-flag at 2025-03-12T15:20:00Z

alex_chung: Nice. Timeline? We want this before the partner webinar on 03/19. If Derek can get the runtime PR in by EOD Friday, we can cut a staging build and Maria can update the tile docs.

derek_liu: I can target EOD Friday for the runtime patch. Console PR will be early next week (Mon/Tue).

kai_ng: I'll draft the onboarding ops-check checklist: run a 1-min smoke trace, verify sample ratio ~expected, check-no-duplicate-trace-ids in DD explorer. Will drop it into the marketplace README and the internal SI handoff doc.

pm_sam: Also add a short blurb for the partner success play: "If customer enables both samplers, contact Redwood Support to toggle runtime sampler remotely" — avoids blocker for initial rollouts.

ellen_wu: I'll add the OTLP + Datadog snippet to the tile README and create a small GIF showing where the Console toggle lives.

maria_gonzalez: Great. Summary for next steps: Derek runtime PR by Fri; Kai ops-check + README checklist; Ellen tile README snippet + GIF; Maria will update marketplace tile copy; Alex will coordinate partner comms for the 03/19 webinar.

alex_chung: Perfect — tagging everyone: please drop any blockers by EOD. :thumbsup:
